newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $811 mln trade deficit in July.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $811 mln trade deficit in July.

text.p: Brazil posted a higher-than-expected trade deficit of $811 million in the month of July, with exports of $5.238 billion and imports of $6.049 billion, the Industry and Commerce Ministry said Tuesday.
The ministry said in a statement that average daily exports in July were $227.7 million against average daily imports of $263 million.
The July result brings the deficit for the year so far to $5.521 billion against $5.539 billion in the whole of 1996.
In the latest Reuters poll, economists had expected the July deficit to come in at about $570 million.
